label: Short obligation level name
summary: The short name of an obligation level (one setting of a subject contract obligation).
details: Vanilla shows it in the administrative government window after the contract type's name, as "Contract: level" for a vassal's obligation details.

label: Has tag
summary: Whether the obligation level carries the given tag; true or false.
details: It takes one argument, the tag. Vanilla's administrative government window uses it to show parts only for levels tagged 'military' or 'byzantine_purple', or for the tag of a merit pool.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tag in quotes, such as 'military', or a function that gives one

label: Is valid
summary: Whether there really is an obligation level here; true or false.
details: Going by its name, it guards against an empty value, like the IsValid functions of other types (for example Government.IsValid in game texts, a hint only). No game file uses it on an obligation level.

label: Obligation level itself
summary: The obligation level itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same obligation level, for example to pass it on as an argument. Game texts show Self only after other things, such as CHARACTER.Self given to a name function; that is a hint, not a use of this function.

label: Level
summary: A function on an obligation checkbox (a contract obligation shown as a checkbox when changing a vassal's contract) that takes one argument; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to one of the checkbox's obligation levels. No game file uses it. The game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, which level.

label: Access checkbox itself
summary: A function on an obligation checkbox that hands back the checkbox itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the checkbox object itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to another type (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf, passed as a data context): a hint only.

label: Checkbox container data
summary: The data behind the container that holds an obligation checkbox; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla's window for changing a vassal's contract sets it as the data context of each checkbox block; the block then shows the obligation's name from it and uses it to decide whether the block is shown at all.

label: Obligation level by index
summary: One obligation level of the checkbox, picked by its number.
details: Vanilla sets level 1 as the data context of the checkbox row (its comment says the first one is always the no effect or disabled option). On a click it selects the level given by GetUnselectedLevelIndex. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number, such as '(int32)1', or a function that gives one

label: Selected level number
summary: A whole number which, going by its name, is the number of the obligation level that is currently selected in the checkbox.
details: No game file uses it. Its counterpart GetUnselectedLevelIndex is used when the box is clicked. The game documents nothing more.

label: Unselected level number
summary: A whole number, the number of the obligation level that is not selected at the moment.
details: Vanilla's contract window passes it to GetLevel when the box is clicked and selects that level; its comment says the order matters: first select the unselected level, then toggle the checkbox. The meaning rests on that comment and the name.

label: Checkbox itself
summary: The obligation checkbox itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same checkbox. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types (such as CHARACTER.Self passed to a name function): a hint only.

label: Toggle checkbox
summary: Toggles the selection of the obligation checkbox; it returns nothing.
details: Vanilla's window for changing a vassal's contract calls it when the box is clicked, right after selecting the unselected level (the file's comment: order dependent, first select the unselected level, then set it as the new selected one).

label: Access connection itself
summary: A function on an obligation line connection (a line joining two obligation levels drawn as a tree in the contract window) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the connection itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Child level
summary: Going by its name, the item at the child end of the connecting line.
details: No game file uses it on this type. The perk tree uses a function of the same name (PerkLineConnection.GetChild.GetItem) for the perk a line leads to: a hint only. The game documents no return type.

label: Line start point
summary: A position on the screen (two numbers, x and y) where the connecting line starts.
details: Going by its name and type. No game file uses it on this type; the perk tree uses the same name to set a line's from point (PerkLineConnection.GetLineFrom), a hint only.

label: Line end point
summary: A position on the screen (two numbers, x and y) where the connecting line ends.
details: Going by its name and type. No game file uses it on this type; the perk tree uses the same name to set a line's to point (PerkLineConnection.GetLineTo), a hint only.

label: Parent level
summary: Going by its name, the item at the parent end of the connecting line.
details: No game file uses it, and the game documents no return type. The game documents nothing more.

label: Connection itself
summary: The obligation line connection itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same connection. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Obligation level option
summary: The obligation level option that one box in the contract window's level tree stands for.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of each box in the tree; the box then reads the option's name, tooltip and whether it is selected or enabled. The game documents no return type.

label: Access tree item itself
summary: A function on an obligation tree item (one box in the tree of obligation levels) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the item itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Tree item content
summary: Going by its name, what the tree item holds, likely its obligation level option.
details: No game file uses it on this type; vanilla uses AccessItem for that. The perk tree uses the same name for a perk (PerkLineConnection.GetChild.GetItem): a hint only. The game documents no return type.

label: Tree item itself
summary: The obligation tree item itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same item. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Set up bottom anchor
summary: Going by its name, hands the given interface element to the tree item as its bottom pin; it gives true or false.
details: Vanilla calls it in a visible line of a widget named "bottom_pin" inside each level box, passing the widget itself (PdxGuiWidget.Self), so it runs while the window is built. The pin is probably where the tree's lines attach; the game does not say so.

label: Set up top anchor
summary: Going by its name, hands the given interface element to the tree item as its top pin; it gives true or false.
details: Vanilla calls it in a visible line of a widget named "top_pin" inside each level box, passing the widget itself (PdxGuiWidget.Self). The pin is probably where the tree's lines attach; the game does not say so.

label: Tree items
summary: The list of items (level boxes) in a tree of obligation levels.
details: Vanilla's window for changing a vassal's contract uses it as a datamodel, so one box is drawn per item. The game documents no return type.

label: Access level tree itself
summary: A function on an obligation level tree (obligation levels drawn as a tree with lines in the contract window) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the tree itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Tree connections
summary: Going by its name, the list of lines that join the levels in the tree.
details: No game file uses it on this type. The perk tree and the domicile window use the same name as a datamodel for their connecting lines: a hint only. The game documents no return type.

label: Tree container data
summary: The data behind the container that holds a tree of obligation levels; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla's contract window sets it as the data context of the tree block, so the parts inside read from it.

label: Item position
summary: The screen position (x and y) at which a given obligation level option is placed in the tree.
details: Vanilla sets each level box's position with it, passing the box's own option.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The obligation level option to place.

label: Tree items
summary: Going by its name, the items of the obligation level tree.
details: No game file uses it on this type; vanilla uses AccessItems for the list. Other types use the same name for their lists (MessageFeedHandler.GetItems): a hint only. The game documents no return type.

label: Level tree itself
summary: The obligation level tree itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same tree. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Set up lines container
summary: Going by its name, registers the given interface element as the place where the tree's lines are drawn, and gives true or false.
details: No game file uses it on this type. The perk tree and the domicile window call the same name in a visible line with PdxGuiWidget.Self: a hint only.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by similar uses, the interface element to draw the lines in.

label: Radio button options
summary: The list of obligation level options in a group of radio buttons (where exactly one level can be chosen).
details: Vanilla's window for changing a vassal's contract uses it as a datamodel, drawing one button per option. The game documents no return type.

label: Access radio group itself
summary: A function on an obligation radio button group that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the group itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Radio group container data
summary: The data behind the container that holds a group of obligation radio buttons; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla's contract window sets it as the data context of the radio button block.

label: Radio group itself
summary: The obligation radio button group itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same group. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access accolade type itself
summary: A function on an obtained accolade type (an accolade type that an accolade has gained, with a rank) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the object itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Accolade rank
summary: A whole number, the rank the accolade has reached in this accolade type.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tooltip of the active rank effects, adds 1 to it for the next rank's effects, and offers an upgrade only while it is below 3 and level-up points are left.

label: Rank effects text
summary: Going by its name, a text describing the effects of the accolade type's rank.
details: No game file uses it; vanilla builds these effect lists with functions on the accolade instead. The game documents nothing more.

label: Accolade type
summary: The accolade type that was obtained.
details: Vanilla reads its name from it (GetName, GetNameNoTooltip, GetNameWithAccolade) in the accolade window and its tooltips. The game documents no return type.

label: Obtained accolade type itself
summary: The obtained accolade type itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla's accolade window passes it to AccoladeView.LevelUpAccoladeType when the upgrade button is clicked, so that this type gains a rank.

label: Access out-of-sync entry
summary: A function on an out-of-sync entry (one player's report when a multiplayer game's state no longer matches the host's) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name, it gives access to the entry itself. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Report folder
summary: Text with the folder where the out-of-sync report was saved.
details: The engine's multiplayer texts show it as "Report created in '...'" in the out-of-sync popup.

label: Playable
summary: The playable (the game's object for a seat that a player can take) of the player in the out-of-sync entry.
details: Vanilla's multiplayer lobby goes on from it to the character (GetPlayable.GetCharacter).

label: Player name
summary: The name of the player whose game went out of sync.
details: The engine's multiplayer texts list it for each entry in the out-of-sync popup.

label: Mismatch type
summary: Text naming the part of the game state where the mismatch was found.
details: The engine's multiplayer texts show it as "Mismatch found in: ..." in the out-of-sync popup.

label: Is local player
summary: Going by its name, whether the out-of-sync entry is about the player at this computer; true or false.
details: No game file uses it on this type. Characters have a function of the same name used in texts to pick "are" or "is": a hint only.

label: Is observer
summary: Whether the player in the entry is an observer (watches the game without a character); true or false.
details: Vanilla's multiplayer lobby shows the character's portrait when there is a character and the player is not an observer, and something else otherwise. The word observer comes from the name.

label: Out-of-sync entry itself
summary: The out-of-sync entry itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same entry. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access out-of-sync window
summary: A function on the out-of-sync window (the popup shown when a multiplayer game's state no longer matches) that hands back the window itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Close
summary: Going by its name, closes the out-of-sync window; it returns nothing.
details: No game file uses it; the popup's own close button calls Continue instead. Lines with the word Close in game texts are unrelated.

label: Continue
summary: Goes on with the game from the out-of-sync popup; it returns nothing.
details: The button's text says what that means: "Continue in single-player" when this computer's own game went out of sync, otherwise "Continue without these Players" (or just "Continue" for a client). Vanilla also calls it from the popup's close button.

label: Out-of-sync entries
summary: The list of out-of-sync entries, one for each player whose game no longer matches.
details: Vanilla lists them in the popup (player name, mismatch type, report folder), and shows the popup only while the list has items.

label: Leave to menu
summary: Leaves the game from the out-of-sync popup; it returns nothing.
details: The button reads "End Game" for the host or a local game and "Leave Game" for other players.

label: Is own game out of sync
summary: Whether it is this computer's own game that went out of sync; true or false.
details: The popup then says this game state differs from the host's and offers to continue in single-player; otherwise it lists the other players that are out of sync.

label: Is multiplayer host
summary: Whether this computer hosts the multiplayer game, going by its name (yes or no).
details: The engine's out-of-sync window (shown when the players' games no longer match) shows its Resynchronize button only when this is true, so only the host can start a resync there. The game's own version of the window checks JominiIsHostOrLocal instead.

label: Resynchronize
summary: Starts a resynchronization of the multiplayer game from the out-of-sync popup; it returns nothing.
details: The button reads "Resynchronize" and vanilla shows it only to the host or in a local game. Going by the word, the players' games are brought back in line with the host's.

label: Out-of-sync window itself
summary: The out-of-sync window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same window. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access option effect
summary: A function on an option effect item (one effect icon shown on an event option) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Affected by trait
summary: Going by its name, whether the option's effect is shaped by a trait; true or false.
details: No game file uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Scheme
summary: The scheme (a plot such as a murder or seduction) that the option's effect is about.
details: Vanilla's event windows show its icon on the option. The game documents no return type.

label: Trait
summary: The trait that the option's effect is about.
details: Vanilla's event and letter windows set it as the data context of the trait icon on the option, shown when IsTrait is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Is critical
summary: Whether the option's stress effect is a critical one; true or false.
details: Vanilla's event windows pick a different stress icon for critical effects. Going by the name and those icons, critical means a large stress change; the game does not say how large.

label: Is death
summary: Whether the option's effect is the death of the character; true or false.
details: Vanilla's event and letter windows show a death icon on the option when it is true. The meaning rests on the name and that use.

label: Is fulfillment
summary: Whether the option's effect is about fulfillment only, without stress; true or false.
details: Vanilla's shared event window marks this case with the comment "only fulfillment, no stress" and shows fulfillment gain or loss icons for it.

label: Is gain
summary: Whether the option's effect is a gain (something is added, for example a trait or stress); true or false.
details: Vanilla's event windows use it to choose between the plus (gain) and minus (loss) icons for traits, stress and fulfillment.

label: Is loss
summary: Whether the option's effect is a loss (something is taken away, for example a trait or stress); true or false.
details: Vanilla's event windows use it to choose the loss icons, the counterpart of IsGain.

label: Is scheme effect
summary: Whether the option's effect is about a scheme; true or false.
details: Vanilla's event and letter windows show the scheme icon (from GetScheme) when it is true.

label: Is secondary gain
summary: Whether the option's effect also brings a second gain alongside its main one; true or false.
details: Vanilla's shared event window combines it with IsGain, IsLoss and IsCritical to pick combined stress and fulfillment icons. What exactly the secondary part is rests on the name.

label: Is secondary loss
summary: Whether the option's effect also brings a second loss alongside its main one; true or false.
details: Vanilla's shared event window combines it with IsGain, IsLoss and IsCritical to pick combined stress and fulfillment icons. What exactly the secondary part is rests on the name.

label: Is stress effect
summary: Whether the option's effect is about stress; true or false.
details: Vanilla's event windows show stress icons on the option when it is true.

label: Is stress and fulfillment
summary: Whether the option's effect changes both stress and fulfillment; true or false.
details: Vanilla's shared event window marks this case with the comment "both stress and fulfillment" and shows combined icons for it.

label: Is trait effect
summary: Whether the option's effect is about a trait; true or false.
details: Vanilla's event and letter windows show the trait icon (from GetTrait) on the option when it is true.

label: Option effect itself
summary: The option effect item itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same item. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access interaction option
summary: A function on an interaction option (a choice such as a checkbox in a character interaction's window) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Can be changed
summary: Whether the player may change the interaction option; true or false.
details: Vanilla's interaction window enables the option's button only when the option is valid and can be changed.

label: Option name
summary: The display name of the interaction option.
details: Vanilla shows it as the option's text in the interaction window.

label: Option tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the interaction option.
details: Vanilla shows it when the mouse is over the option in the interaction window.

label: Has flag
summary: Whether the interaction option carries the given flag; true or false.
details: It takes one argument, the flag. Vanilla's interaction window uses it to show extra parts for the 'grand_wedding_promise' option.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a flag name in quotes, such as 'grand_wedding_promise'

label: Is option chosen
summary: Whether the interaction option is currently switched on; true or false.
details: Vanilla's interaction window ticks the option's checkbox and picks its frame with it.

label: Is shown
summary: Whether the interaction option is shown in the window; true or false.
details: Vanilla's interaction window draws the option only when it is true.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether the interaction option passes the game's own check for it; true or false.
details: Vanilla's interaction window enables the option's button only when it is valid and can be changed. Going by the name, valid may also just mean the option exists; the game does not say which.

label: Click option
summary: What happens when the interaction option is clicked; it returns nothing.
details: Vanilla's interaction window calls it from the option's button. Going by that use, it switches the option on or off.

label: Interaction option itself
summary: The interaction option itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same option. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access faith sort option
summary: A function on a faith sort option (one way of ordering the list in the religion window) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Sort option name
summary: The display name of a sort option in the religion window.
details: Vanilla lists the options from ReligionWindow.GetOrderByOptions and shows this name for each.

label: Faith sort option itself
summary: The faith sort option itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same option. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access ledger sort option
summary: A function on a ledger sort option (one way of ordering the lists in the ledger) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Sort option key
summary: Text with the key of a ledger sort option.
details: Vanilla builds localization keys from it: "sort_l_" plus the key for the drop-down entry, and the key plus "_least" or "_most" for the "Sorted by" line.

label: Sort option text key
summary: Text with the localization key of a ledger sort option.
details: Vanilla's ledger adds "_tt" to it to look up the option's tooltip text, and also tests whether the text under the key itself is empty to decide if the tooltip is shown.

label: Sort option name
summary: Going by its name, the display name of a ledger sort option.
details: No game file uses it on this type; vanilla builds the names from GetKey instead. The lines found for this name belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Ledger sort option itself
summary: The ledger sort option itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same option. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access rite sort option
summary: A function on a rite sort option (one way of ordering a list in the rite window of the faith screens) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Sort option name
summary: The display name of a sort option in the rite window.
details: Vanilla lists the options from RiteWindow.GetOrderByOptions and shows this name for each.

label: Rite sort option itself
summary: The rite sort option itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same option. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access invite rule
summary: A function on an ordered invite rule (one guest category rule in an activity's guest list, in its display order) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Position in list
summary: Going by its name, a whole number with the rule's place in the ordered list.
details: No game file uses it on this type; the lines found for this name belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Invite rule
summary: The activity invite rule (a category of guests that can be invited) behind this entry.
details: Vanilla's guest list window sets it as the data context of the rule's button, which then checks whether the rule is locked. The game documents no return type.

label: Ordered invite rule itself
summary: The ordered invite rule itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla's guest list window passes it to ActivityGuestListWindow.ToggleInviteFromRules on a click, and checks with IsInviteRuleActive whether the rule is on.

label: Access organization
summary: A function on an organization (a group a character belongs to, such as a faith's clergy) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Organization description
summary: The description text of an organization.
details: Vanilla shows it in the organization's tooltip and window. For a faith's clergy the game's text reads "This is the clergy of the ... faith."

label: Organization ID
summary: Going by its name, the organization's internal number (a whole number, never negative).
details: No game file uses it on this type. The game documents nothing more.

label: Members
summary: Going by its name, the list of the organization's members.
details: No game file uses it on this type; the organization window shows its members through OrganizationWindow.AccessMemberList. The game documents no return type.

label: Organization name
summary: The name of an organization.
details: Vanilla shows it as the title of the organization's tooltip and in its window. For a faith's clergy it reads like "Catholic Clergy" (the faith's adjective plus Clergy).

label: Coat of arms
summary: The coat of arms of an organization.
details: Vanilla's character window draws it, 56 by 56 pixels, on the button for the character's organization.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether there really is an organization here; true or false.
details: Vanilla's character window shows the organization button only when the character's organization is valid, so it is false for a character without one.

label: As script scope
summary: Turns the organization into a scope (a general handle that script texts can work with).
details: Going by its name and its return type. No game file uses it on an organization; other types use MakeScope to reach script values and variables: a hint only.

label: Organization itself
summary: The organization itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Vanilla's character window passes it to ToggleGameViewData('organization', ...) on a click, which opens or closes the organization's window.

label: Member list
summary: The member list of the organization window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of the list, which then shows the members as characters (CharacterSelectionList.GetList). The game documents no return type.

label: Access organization window
summary: A function on the organization window that hands back the window itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Close
summary: Closes the organization window; it returns nothing.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close button.

label: Organization
summary: The organization the window shows.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of the whole window, so its name, description and so on come from it. The game documents no return type.

label: Organization window itself
summary: The organization window itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same window. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access friend request
summary: A function on an outgoing friend request (one the player has sent, listed in the engine's friend list window) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Recipient name
summary: The name shown for a friend request the player has sent.
details: The engine's friend list window shows it as the text of each outgoing request. Going by that use, it is the name of the person the request went to.

label: Withdraw request
summary: Removes the outgoing friend request; it returns nothing.
details: The engine's friend list window calls it from the remove button next to the request.

label: Friend request itself
summary: The outgoing friend request itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same request. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access outliner
summary: A function on the outliner (the panel at the side of the screen that lists pinned characters, armies, holdings and more) that hands back the panel itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Close
summary: Going by its name, closes the outliner; it returns nothing.
details: No game file uses it on the outliner; the lines found with the word Close are unrelated texts.

label: Category item count
summary: A whole number, how many entries one category of the outliner holds.
details: Vanilla shows it in the header of each category, for example 'pinned_character', 'players' or 'unit'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a category key in quotes, such as 'pinned_character', 'players' or 'unit'

label: Domicile entries
summary: Going by its name, the outliner's list of domicile entries (a domicile is a ruler's home base).
details: No game file uses it. The game documents no return type and nothing more.

label: Holding entries
summary: The outliner's list of holding entries.
details: Vanilla uses it as a datamodel, drawing one row per holding. The game documents no return type.

label: Pinned characters
summary: The list of characters the player has pinned in the outliner.
details: Vanilla draws one row per pinned character, and shows a placeholder when the category is open but the list is empty.

label: Pinned provinces
summary: The list of provinces the player has pinned in the outliner.
details: Vanilla uses it as a datamodel in the outliner. The game documents no return type.

label: Pinned titles
summary: The list of titles the player has pinned in the outliner.
details: Vanilla uses it as a datamodel in the outliner. The game documents no return type.

label: Players
summary: The outliner's list of players in a multiplayer game.
details: Vanilla uses it as a datamodel in the players category, showing each player's name and character.

label: Army entries
summary: The outliner's list of unit (army) entries.
details: Vanilla draws one row per unit, and shows a placeholder when the 'unit' category is open, the list is empty and there is a player.

label: Is category expanded
summary: Whether one category of the outliner is open (expanded); true or false.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the category's entries, to pick the header's frame and to choose the tooltip text "collapse" or "expand".

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a category key in quotes, such as 'pinned_character' or 'unit'

label: Outliner itself
summary: The outliner itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same panel. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Expand or collapse category
summary: Opens or closes one category of the outliner; it returns nothing.
details: Vanilla calls it when the player clicks a category header.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a category key in quotes, such as 'pinned_character', 'players' or 'unit'

label: Access domicile entry
summary: A function on an outliner domicile entry (a row for a domicile in the outliner) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Building
summary: Going by its name, a domicile building that the outliner entry is about.
details: No game file uses it on this type; the lines found for this name belong to other types: a hint only. The game documents no return type.

label: Domicile
summary: Going by its name, the domicile that the outliner entry stands for.
details: No game file uses it on this type; the lines found for this name (such as CHARACTER.GetDomicile) belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Gold income
summary: A number with fractions, the gold income shown for the domicile entry.
details: Vanilla shows it with a gold icon and two decimals in a domicile text. Going by its name, it is income in gold; the game does not say over what period.

label: Is under construction
summary: Going by its name, whether something in the domicile is being built; true or false.
details: No game file uses it on this type; great projects use the same name: a hint only.

label: Domicile entry itself
summary: The outliner domicile entry itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same entry. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access holding entry
summary: A function on an outliner holding entry (a row for a holding in the outliner) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Holding
summary: Going by its name, the holding that the outliner entry stands for.
details: No game file uses it on this type; vanilla reaches the holding through GetTitle.GetProvince.GetHolding instead. The game documents no return type.

label: Title
summary: The title of the holding in the outliner entry.
details: Vanilla's outliner reads the row's details from it and goes on from it to the province's holding. The game documents no return type.

label: Is selected
summary: Going by its name, whether the holding entry is selected; true or false.
details: No game file uses it on this type; list items elsewhere use the same name to show a pressed button: a hint only.

label: Click holding entry
summary: What happens when the holding entry in the outliner is clicked; it returns nothing.
details: Vanilla calls it from the row's button. The game does not say what the click does.

label: Holding entry itself
summary: The outliner holding entry itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same entry. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access player entry
summary: A function on an outliner player entry (a row for one player of a multiplayer game in the outliner) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.

label: Player character
summary: The character the player in the outliner entry is playing.
details: Vanilla's player row shows the player's name and then this character's name, or another text when there is no valid character.

label: Player status text
summary: A text describing the player in the outliner entry.
details: Vanilla shows it in the row's "joining_status" text, so going by that it tells, for example, whether the player is still joining.

label: Join progress
summary: Going by its name, a number with how far the player has come in joining the game.
details: No game file uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Player name
summary: The name of the player in the outliner entry.
details: Vanilla shows it as the row's text and tooltip, and before the character's name.

label: Is joining
summary: Going by its name, whether the player is still joining the game; true or false.
details: Vanilla's only line with it is commented out, so the game does not really use it.

label: Player entry itself
summary: The outliner player entry itself; the game documents no return type.
details: Going by its name, it hands back the same entry. The lines found for the name Self belong to other types: a hint only.

label: Access output entry
summary: A function on an output entry (one output file in the engine's internal texture importer tool) that hands back the object itself.
details: Going by its name. The game documents no return type, and the interface lines found for this name belong to PdxGuiWidget: a hint only.
